Name: Camera Pan
Author: atravita
Description:
Allows you to freely pan the camera. Pan with the mouse by moving it to the edges of the screen, or pan with the arrow keys.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932]AtraCore[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Uninstall[/size]
Simply delete from your Mods directory.

[size=5]Configuration.[/size]
Run SMAPI at least once with this mod installed to generate the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font], or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure.

[size=4]General Options[/size]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]ToggleBehavior[/font]: Sets how the camera should be toggled on and off. Available options: [font=Courier New]Always[/font] (panning always enabled), [font=Courier New]Never[/font] (panning never enabled), [font=Courier New]Toggle[/font] (a toggle key enables or disables the panning), or [font=Courier New]Camera[/font] (holding the camera object enables the camera. Check Robin for it!).
[*][font=Courier New]UseMouseToPan[/font]: If enabled, moving the mouse to the edges of the screen will cause the camera to pan, <em>if camera panning is enabled</em>.
[*][font=Courier New]ClickAndDragBehavior[/font]: Defines the behavior for clicking-and-dragging. Options are: [font=Courier New]None[/font] (do nothing), [font=Courier New]DragMap[/font] (will move the map under the mouse), and [font=Courier New]AutoScroll[/font] (which is Mozilla-style scrolling). The default button for this is the middle mouse button, but can be set with the [font=Courier New]ClickToScroll[/font] keybind.
[*][font=Courier New]ClickAndDragColor[/font]: As AutoScroll mode draws four tiny arrows on the screen, this lets you set their color.
[*][font=Courier New]ResetWhenDamageTaken[/font]: If enabled, the camera will pan back towards the player if the player takes damage.
[*][font=Courier New]Speed[/font]: Controls how fast the camera pans.
[/list]
[size=4]Panning boundaries[/size]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]XRange[/font]: Controls how far the camera can get away from the player (in the x-direction).
[*][font=Courier New]YRange[/font]: Controls how far the camera can get away from the player (in the y-direction).
[*][font=Courier New]KeepPlayerOnScreen[/font]: If enabled, the camera will not pan sufficiently far to move the player off-screen.
[*][font=Courier New]ShowArrowsToOtherPlayer[/font]: If enabled, other players on the same map will be pointed out by a small arrow.
[*][font=Courier New]SelfColor[/font]: The color of the arrow pointing to the current player.
[*][font=Courier New]FriendColor[/font]: The color of the arrow pointing to any other player on the map.
[/list]
[size=4]Keybinds[/size]
Set any of the keybinds to null to disable.

[list]
[*][font=Courier New]ToggleButton[/font]: The button used to toggle the camera, if [font=Courier New]ToggleBehavior[/font] is set to [font=Courier New]Toggle[/font].
[*][font=Courier New]ResetButton[/font]: The button that resets the camera over the player.
[*][font=Courier New]ClickToScroll[/font]: The button used for the click-and-drag behavior. Defaults to middle-click.
[*][font=Courier New]UpButton[/font], [font=Courier New]DownButton[/font], [font=Courier New]LeftButton[/font], [font=Courier New]RightButton[/font] pan the camera.
[/list]
[size=4]Map-specific camera behavior.[/size]
These control the default map behavior. The four options are:

[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Vanilla[/font]: Completely vanilla camera. No panning, no locking. The camera will in general stay in-bounds.
[*][font=Courier New]Offset[/font]: Panning is enabled, but the camera is not locked.
[*][font=Courier New]Locked[/font]: The default vanilla camera will try to stay in-bounds on the map. This locks the camera to the player's feet, including allowing it to leave the map boundaries.
[*][font=Courier New]Both[/font]: This combines [font=Courier New]Offset[/font] and [font=Courier New]Locked[/font]. The camera will lock to the panned position.
[/list]
Maps are generally categorized as indoor and outdoors and you can set those separately, or you can set a per-map override.

Special notes: the vanilla map property [font=Courier New]ViewportFollowPlayer[/font] automatically engages [font=Courier New]Vanilla[/font] -> [font=Courier New]Locked[/font] and [font=Courier New]Offset[/font] -> [font=Courier New]Both[/font], and this is enabled normally in the mines. Additionally, the map property [font=Courier New]atravita.PanningForbidden[/font] allows map modders to disable panning on their map.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. Should be fine if installed for only one player in multiplayer.
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods. A note on Critter Rings: [font=Courier New]Locked[/font] and [font=Courier New]Both[/font] will effectively disable the Frog Ring's panning.
[/list]
[size=5]See also[/size]
[url=https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/CameraPan]Source[/url]
[url=https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/CameraPan/docs/changelog.md]Changelog[/url]
